name: When should I repair a garage door versus replacing it entirely?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair a garage door versus replacing it entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor cosmetic dents or a single damaged panel can often be repaired, but full replacement is better if your door sags, has severe storm damage, or the panels are no longer manufactured. Replacing the entire system also makes more sense when planning a full garage conversion or workshop upgrade. Installing a new door ensures track alignment, proper spring tension, and modernized safety sensors. Because HH Remodeling handles storm-damage restoration support and general repairs, we inspect whether fixing the existing structure or installing a modern unit provides the best long-term value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor cosmetic issues or single panels if parts exist. Replace if the door has structural warping, storm damage, broken mechanical alignment, or during complete garage remodels.
